citations.desc: Primary enclosures used to transport live birds.
citations.narrative:
Two veterinary medical officers observed 27 transport enclosures transporting approximately 1300 parakeets. This facility
had prepared and delivered these enclosures to a recipient facility where this inspection was performed.
The transport enclosures used for these animals did not provide handholds or handles. The boxes had to be lifted from
the bottom. This could lead to accidental tilting or coming in contact with the birds contained inside while lifting the
enclosures.
Unless the enclosure is permanently affixed to the conveyance, adequate handholds or other devices such as handles
are provided on its exterior, and enable the enclosure to be lifted without tilting it, and ensure that anyone handling the
enclosure will not be in contact with the bird contained inside;
Correction date: August 20, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
Additional Inspectors:
Scott Welch, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
